svg.text: Hi, I'm Vukašin, a final-year Software Engineering student at FON in Belgrade. I like
building AI systems that leave the notebook and run in the real world, with real users,
Agents with guarded tool calling, retrieval over code and documents, MCP servers and LLM
assistants in production. I care about the boring parts that make AI reliable: evaluation,
fallbacks, rate limits and knowing exactly why a model stopped.
Learning NLP and Transformers, and working on the problem that bugs me most: speech and
language models still understand Serbian badly. Monax is where I test it.
Hackathons as team lead, music and organising events, and design. Always happiest when an
idea turns into something people actually use.
